questions.stem: A 45-year-old female known case of T2DM, hypertension, and IHD presented with a history of PND, and orthopnea. Examination revealed bibasal crepitations and an LVS3. 2d echo done showed LVEF-35% and dilated LA. She was started on Diuretics, ACE inhibitors, and B blockers. After one week she presented with a history of lightheadedness and one episode of syncope. The physician attributed these symptoms to the B blocker All are true about starting of B-Blocker therapy in a case of CHF except:

options.label: A
options.text: They should be started with optimum doses

options.label: B
options.text: They should be gradually increased over weeks

options.label: C
options.text: Special precautions should be taken in cases of NYHA class III and IV

options.label: D
options.text: Carvedilol and Metoprolol are the preferred drugs
